headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 1, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates due to a right elbow strain. Bailey Ober has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Minnesota Twins with a right elbow inflammation. Angel Zerpa has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers with left forearm tightness. Craig Kimbrel has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays retroactive to May 28, 2026, due to a right wrist strain. Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants with left plantar fasciitis. Welinton Herrera has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies with left elbow inflammation. Luis Severino has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics with a right shoulder strain. Pierce Johnson has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds retroactive to May 27, 2026, due to a right elbow inflammation.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades and transactions. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key RBI.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, handing the Padres their loss. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 6-7 decision to the Texas Rangers, coming up just short in the final tally. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits in 5 at-bats, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs for the Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Nathan Lukes and Ernie Clement leading the Jays' offense. Gunnar Henderson and Pete Alonso were among the Orioles' top performers in the 5-9 victory.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 2-4 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 2-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with key performances from Jackson Merrill and James Wood on the Padres' side, and Luis García Jr. and Keibert Ruiz contributing for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Griffin's status change was announced on May 31, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
